integer_domain: N1,N2,N3,N4 nonnegative integers; first two direct strict gates N1^3>G2(N2),N2^2>G3(N3); N3>N4; second-row ordering and central condition checked separately
real_relaxation: Only N4 may be real; impose 0<=N4<=N3-1 and retain first two gates and second-row ordering. This is an own relaxation, not a physical state.
arithmetic: rational outward intervals for exclusion and branch certification; independent high-precision Decimal for display/cross-check, never a physical tolerance
selection_policy: ordinary floor only if positive W4<=1 and raw_N4<=a3*N3; otherwise report branch boundary without inventing saturation/transfer
bounds_policy: derive a fresh finite outer box for every cell from positive coefficients, total W_A and unweighted gates; no inherited cutoff
